A colt is 5 feet tall. It will grow 6 inches every month. How tall will it be in 3 years? Think step-by-step, then give your answer. Separate your thinking and the final answer by a line with just three "*" symbols: ***
At the end of your response, please explicitly add a postscript starting with P.P.S
action.label: context

action.content:
The colt starts at 5 feet tall. It grows 6 inches every month. Since there are 12 months in a year, 3 years equals 36 months. The total growth is 36 months multiplied by 6 inches per month, which equals 216 inches. Converting 216 inches back to feet (dividing by 12) gives 18 feet. Adding the initial height of 5 feet to the total growth of 18 feet results in a final height of 23 feet.

***

P.P.S. While this mathematical calculation shows the colt would reach 23 feet, in reality, horses typically stop growing much earlier, around 1.5 to 2 meters tall.
